symbols.read: Price has now closed above the 737.02 invalidation line at 739.43, confirming the 4H bullish flip and converting the combined signal from HOLD to BUY — the previous read's neutral-pending-737.02 stance is resolved to the upside, and the SELL setup at 722.40 is fully dead. The 1H trend stays up with the last bar grinding higher (738.17→739.08), so momentum is aligned across both timeframes and the next objective is the 758.44 upper pivot. Bias is bullish; the level that matters now is 737.02, which flips from confirmation trigger to support — a sustained move back below it would invalidate the long lean and reopen the 722.40 downside toward 686.36. No open FVGs remain, so there is no unfilled gap to pull price back.

The bullish flip is confirmed: price advanced to 82,791.87 and the combined 4H+1H call has upgraded from HOLD to BUY, with the 1H trend still up. The short remains fully invalidated — price is well above the 82,413.00 stop and the 81,033.66 entry is now distant support. The new bear FVG at 82,664.01–82,692.84 sits just below price and is the nearest supply to clear; the bull FVGs at 81,777.63–82,100.00 and 82,171.80–82,211.21 remain the pullback demand zone. Bias is bullish, with 84,352.00 the upside pivot that would confirm continuation and 81,033.66 the lower pivot whose break would revive the bearish case. Invalidation of the bullish lean is a close back below the 81,777.63 FVG base.

Price has held above the 2,403.69 lower pivot at 2,445.24, and the prior constructive bias is confirmed rather than revised — the bullish FVG shelf at 2,403.94–2,409.12 remains the demand base and the 1H trend is still up. What changed is overhead: a new bearish FVG at 2,441.67–2,444.52 has opened directly on price, capping the immediate advance and explaining the flat last 1H bar (-0.02%), while the 4H direction reads bearish against a bullish regime and a HOLD combined signal. Bias stays constructive toward the 2,579.88 upper pivot, but the 2,441.67–2,444.52 gap must be reclaimed to resume the move; invalidation remains a close back below 2,403.69, which reopens the 2,354.54–2,370.66 shelf and the 2,227.50 target.

The bullish-to-neutral bias holds but has lost momentum: price slipped from 106.18 to 106.61 and is still capped below the 107.16 lower pivot, so the long trigger toward 113.40 has not fired. The 1H trend remains up and the FVG list stays empty, keeping the path clear, but the last 1H bar (105.99→106.10) shows weak follow-through and the 107.77 rejection still defines the range top. The SELL setup remains invalidated (entry 107.16, stop 107.19), so the downside case toward 100.92 stays off the table. Bias is neutral-to-bullish pending a clean break of 107.16; invalidation is a close back below the 104.46 zone, which would revive the bear case.

Price has slipped to 57.75, further stalling beneath the 58.41 pivot, and the 57.6195–57.722 bull FVG from the prior read has been consumed — only the lower 57.198–57.367 shelf remains as support. The 4H stays bearish while the 1H trend is still up, keeping the combined signal at HOLD and the bias neutral, unchanged from the prior read. The 58.41 short entry expired untriggered again, so no live position exists. Invalidation is unchanged: a sustained reclaim of 58.41 flips the read bullish toward 61.45, while a clean break below 57.00 through the remaining FVG re-asserts the bearish case toward 55.37.

Price has now broken decisively below the 4,141.44 lower pivot to 4,120.38, confirming the failed-reclaim thesis from the prior read and keeping the bearish bias intact — 4H direction, 1H trend, and combined read all remain SELL. The key shift is that 4,141.44 has flipped from support to resistance, so any retest of that level is now the short trigger rather than a rejection zone to defend. With no open FVGs and a neutral regime, the path to the 4,065.48 target is cleaner, and the invalidation is a sustained reclaim above 4,148.48, which would neutralize the downside case.

Bias stays neutral-to-bullish and has firmed slightly: price pushed from 1.32 to 1.33 (+0.37% on the last 1H), extending the reclaim of the 1.31 lower pivot rather than fading back below it, so the prior read's invalidation condition remains unmet and its stance is confirmed. The 1H trend is still up and the combined 4H+1H signal holds at HOLD with the SELL setup still invalidated, though the 4H direction remains bearish and the BULLISH regime label is the one genuinely new input supporting the upside. Key levels are unchanged: 1.33 is now the support being tested, a sustained push above opens the 1.43 upper pivot, and a drop back under 1.31 revives the 1.20 target. Invalidation: a sustained break back below 1.31.
